lessonCards.title: Incremental changes compound into a brand shift
lessonCards.body: Across 4 snapshots spanning roughly 4 years, no single update here was a dramatic overhaul. The end state looks very different from the start because small, consistent changes in the same direction accumulate. This is worth studying if your own homepage has been drifting without a clear direction.
